task: ae.prolog: Prolog-subset engine with cut, lists, arithmetic and database updates
reasoning_summary: Designed an iterative machine (continuation list, choicepoint stack, trail) so recursion depth is not bounded by the Java stack, with cut barriers recorded per call. Tests were written first: literal semantics for cut/negation/if-then-else, random differential checks against Java (exact arithmetic, list splits, permutations, quicksort) and a parse/format round trip. A 24-mutant run left 7 survivors (one equivalent); each real gap got a dedicated test and was then killed.
